character.name: Pip Nosewick
character.appearance: A rock gnome barely a metre tall, with a magnifying lens permanently strapped over one eye and a nose he insists is professionally trained. Wears a sommelier's sash he awarded to himself. Smells faintly of at least four different cheeses at all times, none of which are his.

story.personality: Announces every observation as if delivering a verdict at a cheese competition. Cannot be told his nose is average.
story.ideals: Somewhere out there is a cheese so perfect it will finally make people take him seriously.
story.bonds: His self-published pamphlet, 'Nosewick's Guide to Provincial Dairy', sold four copies. He knows who bought all four.
story.flaws: Will absolutely follow a smell into an active crime scene before checking if it's safe.
story.backstory: Failed the entrance exam for three separate sommelier guilds — none of which sample cheese, all of which he applied to anyway. Decided credentials were beneath him and started awarding his own.
story.ties: Distantly related to a rock gnome tinkerer who once built a device that could detect lies, sarcasm, and the exact fat content of a wheel of cheese from thirty paces. Pip has not managed to replicate it and refuses to admit that.
